product_desc: Skingenetix PDRN Skin Repair Deep Renewal Treatment: a 30ml frosted ROSE-PINK glass dropper bottle, straight-sided with square shoulders, fitted with a brushed satin aluminium collar and a white rubber-bulb pipette. The glass is a soft dusty rose-pink, deeper through the middle and lighter towards the shoulders and base - keep it PINK and do not render it white, clear, amber or peach. The collar metal is NEUTRAL SILVER-GREY with a fine vertical brushed grain and stays neutral next to the pink glass - never rose-gold, copper, champagne, brass or warm-tinted, and never a chrome mirror. PIPETTE PROPORTIONS: the white rubber bulb is an ELONGATED CAPSULE about 1.6 times taller than wide, standing about ONE THIRD the height of the glass body; bulb plus collar together about TWO THIRDS of it. Never short, squat, stubby or ball-shaped. Reproduce the front label exactly as in the reference, every character verbatim. These are the ONLY words on the bottle, in this order: (1) the Skingenetix DNA-helix mark with the wordmark 'Skingenetix', spelled with a capital S and the rest lower case, no trademark or copyright symbol anywhere; (2) 'PDRN' then 'SKIN REPAIR' - bold capitals, two lines; (3) 'DEEP RENEWAL' then 'TREATMENT' - two lines; (4) 'PREMIUM FORMULA'; (5) '1% (10,000 PPM) PDRN  |  30ML' in small capitals. A narrow vertical rule sits to the left of the text block. INK COLOURS - these describe the ink each line is printed in and are NEVER themselves printed as words: lines 2, 4 and 5 are printed in black ink; line 3 and the vertical rule are printed in rose ink; the mark and wordmark are black. No colour name ever appears as text. THE BOTTLE CARRIES ONLY THE LINES LISTED ABOVE - not the benefit triplet, not 'ALL SKIN TYPES', not any ingredient list. Those are carton-only. BRAND ACCENT COLOUR: ROSE, a soft dusty antique pink. Any brand colour, gradient or accent glow builds from that rose and warm neutrals - never gold, purple, blue, green or orange.

packaging_desc:
The product carton is a tall slim rectangular box, 41 x 41 x 99mm, noticeably taller than it is wide. It has TWO large faces in different colours meeting at crisp edges, each colour holding right up to the edge. One large face is matte metallic dusty pink; the other is matte metallic brushed pale silver - not white cardboard, not a mirror. Both large faces carry the SAME lines, in this order top to bottom, and these are the ONLY words printed on them:
1. the Skingenetix DNA-helix mark with the wordmark 'Skingenetix'
2. 'PDRN' then 'SKIN REPAIR' - bold capitals, two lines
3. 'DEEP RENEWAL' then 'TREATMENT' - two lines
4. 'ANTI-AGING' / 'MULTI-LEVEL REPAIR' / 'CELLULAR RESTORATION' - three lines
5. 'PREMIUM FORMULA'
6. 'ALL SKIN TYPES' - small
7. '1% (10,000PPM) PDRN  |  30ML' - small capitals
A narrow vertical rule sits to the left of the text block.
INK COLOURS - these describe the ink each line is printed in and are NEVER themselves printed as words. On the pink face: lines 1, 3 and 6 and the vertical rule are printed in white ink, everything else in black ink. On the silver face: those same elements are printed in rose ink and the rule is rose, everything else black. No colour name ever appears as text.
The narrow side panels are printed in the same pink and silver and carry ingredient and directions text too small to read - render it as fine unreadable print, never as placeholder words. FINISH: the dieline specifies 'Mat Metalic Pink' and 'Mat Metalic Silver', luxury satin. Render a soft brushed sheen with broad diffuse falloff across each face - never a mirror, never polished foil, never chrome. PRINT NOTHING NOT LISTED ABOVE - do not invent, translate, paraphrase or add wording, claims or ingredient names on any face.
